ordered_operations: draw exactly seven minus kept-size refill cards
reject an attempted keep below four
preconditions: The binding league override, not the London mulligan, controls this procedure.
required_assertions: rejected hands are returned and shuffled before the next candidate hand
every kept hand is refilled to exactly seven cards
a keep below four is rejected

plain_english: The league procedure presents an initial seven-card hand and, if rejected, one free replacement seven-card hand.
Later candidate hands contain six, five, and four cards; the simulator never mulligans below four.
Rejected hands return to the library and are shuffled before the next candidate hand, and a kept hand below seven is refilled to seven afterward.
title: League mulligan offers a free second seven, stops at four, and refills to seven
